# Image Asset — Networked Mars Settlement

Original file: `a_wide_cinematic_sci_fi_landscape_scene_on_a_reddi.png`

Format in original package: PNG.

Description: A wide cinematic Mars landscape showing a settlement, rover, astronaut, industrial equipment and a communications network spanning the scene.

Presentation role: Hero and mission-context imagery. It communicates that research, engineering, robotics, infrastructure and communications operate as one connected system.

Restored Version 1 concept: This image represents the shared digital brain and multi-harness ecosystem. Scientific, engineering, program-management and operational skills connect through governed memory rather than one monolithic agent.

Primary slide uses: Opening, Mars application context and ecosystem framing.

Accessibility text: “A Mars settlement with astronaut, rover, habitat, industrial equipment and orbital communication links.”

September 2026 alignment: The connected settlement now represents mission capability rather than abstract intelligence. Each link implies an explicit work product, governed tool path, evidence status and approval state within the Mars Harness.


---

## Version 5 use

Settlement imagery now supports the opening and closing claim that the intelligence layer spans science, engineering, physical build, and operations. It is contextual rather than evidentiary and must not imply a qualified settlement design.
